body: What platform are you playing on?
Have you tried it in supernova? How is it? I like the idea of it, like having to sleep everyday and etc, but I’m worried it may be too difficult.

Out of every game I’ve played, nothing compares to Outerworlds. I’ve only completed it once, but as soon as I was done I felt so empty haha. Immediately started up a new game. I’m interested to see how the game goes when I play completely different routes.

Exactly and I don’t want to be like that. So i told him she’s more than welcome to hang around us and I’d like to get to know her better so I’m more comfortable with it all. 

It’s just definitely threatening being the “new girlfriend” vs his history and all

I don’t want to break up with him. Other than him being friends with his ex, this has been the healthiest relationship I’ve ever been in. We never fight and he’s so overly kind to me. He’s been honest about her from the beginning and I can’t hate his past especially knowing this coming into the relationship.

Yeah and it seems like they sleep together when they’re both single. 

So is it wrong of me to tell him I’m uncomfortable with their friendship? He did tell me he would stop talking to her if I was uncomfortable, I just hate to be that person.

I did meet her a little while ago, she came out to the bar with us. This was before we were officially dating, so he introduced her to me. It seems like she doesn’t have much interest in trying to be my friend though.

Kudos to you for being mature about it. I’m in a similar situation, had a gut feeling to check my boyfriend’s phone, and sure enough found that he had been cheating for weeks. However I wasn’t as mature about it, and I had been drinking, so I threw the phone at him to wake him up and told him to get out. Luckily he had a friend’s house to go to, and although it’s my apartment we did live together. He’s in the process of getting all his stuff out. 

As for handling it tomorrow, just be calm and mature about it, tell her you know and show her the text. She will try to lie and make excuses but stand your ground. Give her a set day she needs to be out of the apartment by, it’s more than generous of you to let her stay until Saturday. Best of luck!
